subject: Introducing your new Brightline account manager
text:
Hi Melissa,

I wanted to introduce Rachel Kim, who is taking over as your account manager effective today. Rachel has been with Brightline for six years and knows your account well. You can reach her at rkim@brightlineoffice.com or 614-555-0161.

Tom Reyes has moved to our Cincinnati branch. For billing and collections, please continue to work with Carla Benson.

Best,
Dev Patel
Controller, Brightline Office Supply
